general.title: AWS Releases a Free Local Emulator of AWS Built Entirely by Agents
general.describe: AWS has released AWS Emulator, a free, CC0-licensed local stand-in for more than 200 of its services, generated from its public API models and aimed at the test loops of coding agents. AWS says agents wrote and maintain all of the code and publishes per-release fidelity scores. The docs say it does not evaluate IAM, and practitioners are split on trusting an emulator nobody reviewed. By Steef-Jan Wiggers
